_comments: Daily cash-flow SMS system — settings. Edit the values below, never the keys.
Keys beginning with an underscore are documentation only and are ignored by the code.
timezone .......................... IANA timezone name. All dates and the send-time
check are evaluated in this zone. Handles EDT/EST
automatically.
send_hour_local ................... Hour (0-23, local) the daily brief is sent. The
workflow runs twice (11:00 and 12:00 UTC) and the
script exits without sending unless the local hour
matches this value. That is what makes the daylight
saving switch a non-event.
sms_provider ...................... 'twilio' or 'email_gateway'. Selects which code path
messaging.py uses. Both work; the gateway exists so
Twilio A2P 10DLC registration cannot block you.
parser_model ...................... Anthropic model id used to read uploaded bill
screenshots and spreadsheets. Change it here rather
than in code.
projection_days ................... How many days forward to project, starting today.
low_balance_threshold ............. A projected day at or below this is CRITICAL.
warning_buffer .................... A projected day at or below this (but above the
critical threshold) is a CAUTION.
daily_discretionary_allowance ..... Planned everyday spending per day, in dollars. Used
for the forward projection and to work out how much
of today's allowance is still unspent.
discretionary_exclude_keywords .... Case-insensitive substrings. A transaction whose
description contains any of these is never counted
as discretionary spending — transfers, card payments
already modelled as bills, and so on.
account_ids ....................... SimpleFIN account ids to include. An empty list means
every account the bridge returns.
paycheck_matching_keywords ........ Case-insensitive substrings used to recognise income
deposits in the transaction feed.
